title: Low-Resource Walloon Speech Synthesis
description: Developed and evaluated VITS-based text-to-speech systems for Walloon using recordings from two speakers. The study compared grapheme and phoneme input representations and Walloon-only training with transfer learning from French-pretrained models. Evaluation combined objective speech metrics with a perceptual study involving 23 native Walloon speakers.

title: Agent-Based Natural-Language Interface for Structured Data
description: Developed an analyst-facing system that translated natural-language questions into executable SQL for internal financial-data analysis. The agent determined which information and tools were needed before SQL generation, narrowing the database context through schema retrieval and table relationships instead of passing the full database description to the model.
result: The system reached 87.5% end-to-end accuracy on a 48-question internal benchmark, while hybrid table retrieval reached 95% top-k accuracy.

title: Semi-Autonomous Rover for Precision Agriculture
affiliation: Mobile Robotics Laboratory, University of São Paulo
description: Contributed to a semi-autonomous agricultural rover designed to support soil-composition measurements using laser-induced breakdown spectroscopy (LIBS). I developed and integrated the rover's propulsion and steering control system, selected electronic components under power and environmental constraints, and participated in prototype and controlled field testing.
